resources.string: No site assigned yet. Ask your administrator to assign you to a site, then refresh.
This is not the Bluetooth pairing code. Use the six-digit approval code shown on the touchscreen.
Use only letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores, up to 64 characters.
Approved. Device %1$s can use your nurse permissions until %2$s.
Wrong code. Check the six digits on the touchscreen and enter them again. If the screen now shows a different code, use the new one.
Code expired. Request a new approval code on the touchscreen, then enter it here.
Approval denied. A nurse can only approve a screen at their own assigned site, and the account must be approved. Contact your site administrator.
No device with that name was found. Check the device name shown on the touchscreen.
Your sign in has expired. Sign in again, then retry.
Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
No connection. Connect to the internet, then press Approve again. Your entries have been kept.
Approval could not be completed. Try again in a moment.
Authorisation: none this session. Approve a touchscreen above.
Authorisation: expired at %1$s. Approve the screen again to continue.
Uploads from this screen accepted until %1$s
Recording and upload status has not been supplied yet. Nothing is shown as uploaded until the device service reports it.
Patient selection and recording are done on the touchscreen.
Your approval has expired. Enter the new six-digit code shown on the touchscreen.
No code needed. This was checked automatically and your approval is active until the shift expires.
